title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Medicaid Rate Share by Home Oxygen Therapy Class
content:
**Rate schedule.** In an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility crossover, the rate share of the Medicaid monthly rate follows the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy system class, as recorded on the patient's rental-active oxygen record. The share is the percentage of the monthly fee the rate takes, applied before the rate is rounded to the cent.

| Home Oxygen Therapy class furnishes | Classes | Rate share |
|---|---|---|
| portable cylinders or a home fill system | Concentrator with Portable Cylinders; High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders; Concentrator with Home Fill System | 100 percent |
| a liquid oxygen system or a portable oxygen concentrator | Liquid Oxygen System; Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator | 92 percent |
| a stationary concentrator alone | Stationary Concentrator Oxygen | the Medicaid record's allowed-amount percentage of the fee schedule (82 percent for Medicaid Fee-for-Service) |

**Illustration (hypothetical monthly fee of 200.00).** A Concentrator with Home Fill System patient: 100 percent, 200.00. A Liquid Oxygen System patient: 92 percent, 184.00. A Stationary Concentrator Oxygen patient with a Medicaid Fee-for-Service record: 82 percent, 164.00.
